title: Sentiment Drips
tagline: Sentiment Drips is a flexible Allo framework that gives you building blocks to deploy liquidity to fund impact projects. Allo is a sophisticated ecosystem on the Ethereum blockchain, enabling automated and decentralized fund allocation and distribution.
description: Sentiment Drips is a dynamic framework within the Allo ecosystem, operating on the Ethereum blockchain. It equips you with versatile building blocks to efficiently allocate and distribute liquidity, supporting impactful initiatives. Automate and decentralize your fund allocation with Allo's advanced tools.
how_its_made: Sentiment Drips is a framework closely tied to the Allo protocol, using its core contracts as a base. It introduces custom contracts that fine-tune the way capital is distributed, ensuring it aligns perfectly with the needs of impact projects. To make this process even smoother, Sentiment Drips leverages the Drips network, efficiently sending tokens to those who receive funding. In simple terms, it's all about optimizing how money is distributed within the Allo ecosystem for impactful projects.
